user.title: Connect to your Xcel meter
user.description: Enter the local IP address and port of your Itron meter. If the meter was discovered automatically, these fields are already filled in.

lfdi.title: Register this LFDI
lfdi.description:
Register the following LFDI for this meter on the [Xcel Launchpad]({launchpad_url}) before continuing.

**LFDI:** `{lfdi}`

The meter will reject the connection until the LFDI is registered. The integration retries automatically, so you can also submit now and register afterwards.

existing.title: Existing credentials
existing.description: Enter the certificate and private key paths. Relative paths are resolved against the Home Assistant configuration directory. The certificate must already be registered with Xcel.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Xcel meter
reconfigure.description: Update the meter address. The existing certificate and key are reused.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the meter. Check the IP address, port and network.
error.invalid_auth: The meter rejected the client certificate. Verify that the LFDI is registered with Xcel.
error.invalid_certificate: The certificate or private key could not be read.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while contacting the meter.

abort.cannot_connect: The discovered meter did not provide a usable address.
abort.certificate_generation_failed: The client certificate could not be generated.

credentials_rejected.title: Xcel meter rejected the client certificate
credentials_rejected.description: The meter at {host} rejected the client certificate. Verify that LFDI `{lfdi}` is registered for this meter on the [Xcel Launchpad]({launchpad_url}). The integration will keep retrying.
